items.title: 71231_Sam Wooding Oral History Interview
items.q: Charlie Johnson was about three or four years older than I was... He taught me a lot of things.

ctx.x: Because Eubie was very good, you see, and he was getting better all the time.

So, now, Jack the Bear, she worked with Jack the Bear. That's when they first heard this piece, 'You Made Me Love You, I Didn't Want to Do It'. Well, Jack the Bear was very good. He was good for hokum, but he wasn't in no comparison with Eubie Blake.
